I didn't record Ilse's 25 November date, because our records say the Brackenwater Freight Co. renewal date is 30 November 2026. I replied in her #north-team thread to ask which date is right.

- **What our records say:** the signed 2025–2026 renewal order form gives the renewal date as 30 November 2026. The account page (last updated 30 September) and Dana Okafor's handover email to Marcus and Ilse also say 30 November.
- **Another mismatch:** a CRM note from February 2026 gives 31 December 2026, which also disagrees with the signed form.
- **What I asked her:** whether 25 November is a new date, such as an internal target to get it signed early, or whether it should be 30 November. Nothing will change until she answers.

Only North team members are in that channel, and a renewal date isn't a finance figure, so it was fine to share there. I left out all prices and discounts.
